research.facts:
Rockets & Mavericks Media Day / China Games
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- September 22, 2026 is the first NBA media day of the 2026-27 season — Rockets and Mavericks only
- All other 28 teams hold media day on September 28, 2026
- Rockets and Mavericks open training camp Sept. 22–23, a week before the rest of the league
- NBA China Games 2026: Rockets vs. Mavericks, Oct. 9 and Oct. 11 at The Venetian Arena in Macao
- Cooper Flagg won NBA Rookie of the Year in 2025-26 (averaged 21 pts, 6.7 reb, 4.5 ast)
- Kevin Durant is on the Houston Rockets
- Durant publicly praised Flagg: said he "will be considered one of the best of all time"
- Mavericks also have Anthony Davis; Davis confident Flagg ready to defend Durant
- Flagg turned 20 in December 2025; this is his second NBA season
- All other training camps: September 29; preseason begins October 3; regular season opens October 20
**Sources:** Eastern Herald, Dallas Sports Journal, NBA.com, CBS Sports, Hoops Rumors

research.facts:
Duren Qualifying Offer Deadline
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Oct. 1, 2026 deadline for Duren to accept qualifying offer — now 9 days away (from Sept. 22)
- Duren's qualifying offer: $9.6 million for 2026-27 season
- Detroit's reported offer: approximately $35 million per year
- Duren reportedly seeking approximately $40 million per year
- Duren earned third-team All-NBA honors in 2025-26
- Pistons finished with 60 wins, Eastern Conference No. 1 seed in 2025-26
- Report: Duren could skip Pistons media day (Sept. 28) amid stalemate
- If Duren accepts QO, he becomes an unrestricted free agent next summer
- Hard final QO acceptance deadline: March 1, 2027
- Pistons' rotation would change dramatically if Duren plays on the QO
**Sources:** CBS Sports, TalkBasket, Eastern Herald, Detroit Bad Boys, Last Word on Basketball

Giannis / Miami Heat Camp
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Giannis Antetokounmpo traded from Milwaukee Bucks to Miami Heat on July 6, 2026
- Ended a 13-season run with Milwaukee
- Two-time NBA MVP
- Heat additions this offseason: Giannis, Klay Thompson, Bobby Portis, Tim Hardaway Jr.
- Giannis skipped Greece's FIBA qualifiers to participate in Heat's unofficial minicamp in California
- Unofficial minicamp has been ongoing for weeks
- Official training camp opens September 29 at Kaseya Center in Miami
- Head coach: Erik Spoelstra; President: Pat Riley
- First Heat preseason game: October 3
**Sources:** Allucanheat, Hoopswire, Heavy.com, Eastern Herald, BVM Sports

Timberwolves LaMelo / Trade Candidates
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Timberwolves acquired LaMelo Ball from Charlotte Hornets; trade headlined by Naz Reid (former Sixth Man of the Year) plus picks package
- Jonathan Kuminga signed with Minnesota this offseason
- Projected starting lineup: Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball, Rudy Gobert, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga
- Rudy Gobert remaining contract: 2 years, $75 million (player option)
- Donte DiVincenzo on the roster but facing possible trade or missing entire 2026-27 season
- If DiVincenzo is traded, Wolves can only re-sign him via taxpayer mid-level exception
- Camp opens September 29
**Sources:** Yahoo Sports, ClutchPoints, Star Tribune, Canis Hoopus
